name: Gen 1&2 Soundtrack
author: HyruleChosenOne
tagline: 43 classic Kanto & Johto music tracks (FRLG, HGSS & GB Sounds) plus 6 iconic SFX added alongside every vanilla song.
description: Expanded additive Gen 1 & Gen 2 Pokémon soundtrack and sound effects mod curated from FireRed/LeafGreen, HeartGold/SoulSilver, and authentic 8-bit GB Sounds archives. Registers 10 nostalgic menu themes, 20 battle/route/dungeon themes into the in-game music rotation, 13 legendary & champion boss themes into the boss pool, and 6 classic SFX stings — all without overwriting or removing a single vanilla PokéBonk track.
highlights: 10 selectable main menu themes: Title Screen (FRLG & HGSS), Pallet Town, New Bark Town, National Park, Route 1, Route 29, Goldenrod, Ecruteak & Cerulean City
20 in-game battle & dungeon themes: Wild, Trainer, Gym Leader, Rival, Team Rocket, Rocket Hideout, Silph Co., Victory Road, Pokémon Tower, Battle Tower & GB Sounds classics
13 legendary & champion boss themes: Mewtwo, Legendary Birds, Deoxys, Champion Blue/Lance/Red, Ho-Oh, Lugia, Raikou, Entei, Suicune, Frontier Brain & Super-Ancient
6 short iconic SFX clips (Level Up, Item Get, Heal, Caught, Badge Get & Evolution) routed through PokéBonk's native SFX slider
100% additive — every vanilla PokéBonk song remains selectable and intact
